entries.body: Words and Short Phrases describes highly familiar individual words or groups of words associated with highly familiar contexts, routines and experiences.
un chat, un chien, une pomme
Understanding may be shown through an action, gesture, facial expression, selecting, matching or pointing. A spoken response is not always required.
Articles are used with nouns (e.g. une banane, le chat)
Articles with nouns (e.g. une banane, le chat) when modelled
Learners may reuse familiar patterns such as J’aime le foot. C’est super! Je n’aime pas le basket.
